articles.summary: HARTFORD, Conn., June 25, 2026 The Hartford will release its second quarter 2026 financial results at approximately 4:05 p.m. EDT on Thursday, July 23. The company will host a webcast at 9 a.m. EDT on Friday, July 24, to discuss the results. The webcast will be available on the investor relations section of the companys website, https://ir.thehartford.com , and made available for replay, along with a transcript of the event, for at least one year.
